snippet.title: The Stars Are Not Ready | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
▶ Play the free demo: https://turtlevaniagames.com/demo/stars/yts

The Stars Are Not Ready is a neon arcade roguelite where momentum is the only weapon. There is no trigger to hold. You surf a vast dark void, ram everything to dust at full speed, charge your core to OVERLOAD, and tear a path across the zones to the guardians waiting at the edge of the dark.

What you'll do:
• Smash asteroids, towers, and hunters apart by hitting them hard enough, then ride the wreckage into the next kill
• Charge your energy to OVERLOAD and become the most dangerous thing in the zone
• Survive reality-bending anomalies: swarms, gold rushes, volatile geometry, magnetic storms
• Route your dive between zones, evolve run-warping mutations, and break the guardians at the edge of the dark
• Fully procedural neon visuals, a synthesized score, and full controller support

The stars are not ready. Go anyway.

▶ Play it now: https://turtlevaniagames.com/demo/stars/yts
